Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.olga

Class SyntheticWellTrajectory.Statistics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.olga.SyntheticWellTrajectory.Statistics
Enclosing class:
SyntheticWellTrajectory
public static final class SyntheticWellTrajectory.Statistics extends Object
A depth-tier statistics basis -- the depth tiers, default max inclination, and a human-readable provenance description together, mirroring the ported Python module's own statistics= parameter (an already-loaded statistics dict). This class has no built-in instance -- every caller supplies its own, from whatever internally governed data source it has rights to use; see this class's own "Data governance" Javadoc section.
